## Text
Every agreement by which anyone is restrained from exercising a lawful profession, trade or business of
any kind, is to that extent void.

## In plain words
A clause that stops someone from working in their trade is generally void in Malaysia, apart from narrow
exceptions such as the sale of a business.

## When it matters in an NDA or service agreement
Non-compete and non-solicitation clauses.
